svg.title: Red Green
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Observed oblique two-panel outline and division preserved; not converted to a horizontal rectangle. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/FC.518/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
